thread.text:
Today: Bench Press (Dumbbell) hit prescription weight but ran three sets instead of two — 24kg×8 warm-up, then 28kg×8, 10, 10. First set stayed at the floor of the 10-12 range, same as 10-04, but sets two and three pushed past it. Chest Supported Row matched the prescribed 18kg×10,10,10 exactly, trial run 3 of 4 holding steady. Face Pull hit the top of its range for the first time, 17.5kg×15,15,15, across three sets rather than the prescribed two. Hammer Curl dropped to 16kg×8,8,8, well under its 10-12 target and under last session's numbers at the same load. Lateral Raise swapped again from the dumbbell anchor to cable — 5kg×8,8,8, nowhere near the 15-20 target and down from 5kg×10,10,10 on 10-04. Hanging Leg Raise matched the bottom of its range, bodyweight×10,10.

Trend: Face pull needs one more session at 15,15,15 to earn the move to 20kg. Chest supported row has now held 18kg for 10+ reps across three straight sessions (09-26, 10-04, today) — one trial run left before the keep-or-drop call. Hammer curl had logged 12,12,12 then 10,10,10 the last two times; today's 8,8,8 breaks that pattern for the first time. The lateral raise anchor hasn't actually run on dumbbells since 09-28 — both times it's shown up since, it's been the cable version, and reps have now fallen from 10s to 8s on that machine.

Next session: Lower, Sun 1 Nov. Squat 62.5kg, two sets of 8, 2 reps in reserve — this is the session to under-do, not push. RDL anchor 70kg for three sets of 8, slow on the way down, full loads resume next week.

Question: the lateral raise's been cable twice now instead of the prescribed 8kg dumbbell anchor, and reps dropped from 10s to 8s today — is that a deliberate swap, or did something feel off on the raise itself?
i do the dumbbell raise on mondays

Got it — that fits the data: every Monday log (09-28, 10-19, 10-26) shows the dumbbell version, and every Upper C log (09-26, 10-04, today) shows the cable version. Two different slots doing two different jobs, not a swap or a decline. The anchor progression rule (20 holds on all three sets at 8kg) only applies to the Monday dumbbell version, which is currently sitting at 7-8kg for 15s.

That still leaves the Upper C cable number itself: 5kg×8,8,8 today versus 5kg×10,10,10 on 10-04, same load, same slot position. Nothing in the log explains that drop — not fatigue from session order, not a load change. Worth knowing if that was just an off day or if something felt different in the shoulder on the cable movement specifically.
